name: 3S Viking Status
author: Joakim
description: Tabbed Viking HUD panel fed by the BBE viking feed: Stats / City / Builds / Production / People / Settlers / Holds / Sea / Voyage / Map / Travel / Plan / Mission / Trade / Trade Auto / Trade Log / Feeds. Includes the build planner and the market scanner + auto-trader, formerly the separate 3s-build and 3s-market plugins.
